name: Galette
source:
The Mayor of this commune. It’s thanks to his efforts that people call La Bête a paradise for kemomimis. He’s kind, friendly, and pretty darn handsome—but his stern gaze can be a bit scary. Seems he hasn’t grown a tail yet.

[From the in-game character profile]
